CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 21, 2021

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia

  Absent:  Gardea

  Tang arrived at 7:08 p.m.

  Staff Present: Andrew Ho, Director; Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal
  Planner; Mario Arellano, Assistant Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by Vice President Garcia

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-29, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-20-06 AND TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TP 83396
  • 2970-2990 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Artem Golestian
  • Request: This is an application for Planned Development Permit PD-
  20-29, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-06 and Tentative Parcel Map
  TP 83396 to merge 2 lots into 1 and to construct a new 2,993 square
  foot fully automated car wash on a site of approximately 18,199 square
  feet located at 2970-2990 West Valley Boulevard in the VSP (Valley
  Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone in the City of Alhambra (This
  item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act).

  1
  06/21/2021
   •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-13, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-29, Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  20-06, and Tentative Parcel Map TP 83396 subject to the Conditions
  of Approval.
  •  Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Artem Golestian, Applicant, Claire Pincock, MD Acoustics, and
  Malcolm Arakelian, Business Owner, provided the Applicant
  presentation and were available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  ORIGINAL MOTION:
  • Moved to continue the project with the Applicant to provide additional
  information on the traffic and intersection study including the queuing time
  and the potential impact to the two main streets adjacent to the site, as
  well as add to the document any additional features to add to the project
  to mitigate the Commission’s concerns.
  • Friendly amendment by Vice President Garcia for staff to do a more robust
  analysis on the Valley Boulevard Specific Plan.
  • Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.

  SUBSTITUTE MOTION:
  • Substitute motion to deny the project and direct staff to return to the
  Planning Commission with a Resolution for denial.
  • Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Tang.
  • The substitute motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-4-0-1
  Ayes:  Olson, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang
  Noes:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Garcia
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Gardea

F.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT

  •  There was no Director’s Report.

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no public comments.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Tang commented that he drove by a project on Valley Boulevard and
  witnessed a lot of dust coming from construction work. He suggested the City do more
  to mitigate the dust.

  2
  06/21/2021
 I.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:55 P.M. to Monday,
  July 19, 2021, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President

ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant

  06/21/2021
